mechanism: Both drugs can cause metabolic acidosis and carbonic anhydrase inhibition by dorzolamide may increase valproic acid levels; dorzolamide may also increase risk of nephrolithiasis and electrolyte disturbances in patients on valproic acid.
action: Monitor serum valproic acid levels, renal function, and electrolytes; assess for signs of metabolic acidosis; consider alternative carbonic anhydrase inhibitor if possible.
